item.title: 🎉 Passed my Ph.D. qualifier in CS — AI
item.description: I passed my Computer Science Ph.D. qualifying exam in the Artificial Intelligence area at Georgia Tech.

item.title: 🏆 First place at the Graduate Poster Symposium
item.description: I received first place in the Junior Student category at the Georgia Tech College of Computing Graduate Poster Symposium for my research on multimodal sensing for health and well-being.

item.title: 🧑‍🏫 Started teaching Designing and Building User Interfaces
item.description: I began serving as a graduate teaching assistant for the online CS 8801 Designing and Building User Interfaces, where I designed the syllabus and curriculum and led biweekly seminars for the class.

item.title: ✅ Presented research to Georgia Tech President Cabrera
item.description: I had the chance to present our health-sensing research to Georgia Tech President Ángel Cabrera, discussing how multimodal sensing can support health and well-being.

item.title: 🧠 Started my Ph.D. at Georgia Tech
item.description: I started my Computer Science Ph.D. in the School of Interactive Computing at Georgia Tech, joining the Ka Moamoa Lab to work on human-AI interaction and multimodal sensing.
